releases.name: Version 1.29.7
releases.body:
## Bug fixes

- Log errors and prevent users from creating NHItems with the WarpCore type, as those must extend the WarpCoreItem class and should be done with custom code. #1121 
- Fixed an issue when reloading configs while having preloaded bundles. #1101 and #1130.
- Fixed an issue where the wrong GhostBird prefab could be taken by a detail. When failing to find an object by path, SearchUtilities now checks for an object with the correct name and correct parent name. Fixes #1136.
- Fixed the AWC in the Vessel vanishing sometimes when warping back from DB. Fixes #1057.
- Fix supernova scaling improperly depending on chosen speed. Fixes #1150.

## Documentation
- Recommended prefixing ship log fact/entry IDs and dialogue condition IDs with the name of your mod to prevent possible incompatibility issues. #1087
- Documented recommended cloak sizes (at least x6 the size of the planet) #1089
 

**Generated From PR: https://github.com/Outer-Wilds-New-Horizons/new-horizons/pull/1159**
releases.bodyZh:
## 错误修复

- 记录错误并阻止用户创建类型为WarpCore的NHItems，因为这些必须扩展WarpCoreItem类，并且应该使用自定义代码完成。 #1121 
- 修复了在加载预加载包时重新加载配置时的问题。 #1101 和 #1130。
- 修复了一个问题，即当通过路径查找对象失败时，某个细节可能会获取到错误的GhostBird预制体。现在SearchUtilities在查找对象失败时会检查具有正确名称和正确父名称的对象。修复 #1136。
- 修复了在从DB传送回船体时AWC有时会消失的问题。修复 #1057。
- 修复超新星缩放不正确的问题，取决于选择的速度。修复 #1150。

## 文档说明
- 建议在飞船日志事实/条目ID和对话条件ID前加上你的模组的名称，以防止可能的不兼容问题。 #1087
- 记录了推荐的隐形衣尺寸（至少是行星大小的6倍） #1089
 

**来自PR：https://github.com/Outer-Wilds-New-Horizons/new-horizons/pull/1159**

releases.name: Version 1.29.5
releases.body:
## Minor features

- Updated Chinese Translation (thanks @SanBaiMing)
- Added `QueryAddonManifest` to API and `extras` to addon manifest
- Added `gravityVolumeLayer` to `Base`
- Added `quantumToggleVolume` to `Volumes`. Toggles the ability for specified quantum objects to change their quantum state when entering the volume.
- Added an "airborne" mode to the debug raycast. Lets you pick a point in front of your camera and get its position and rotation.
- Added `SurfaceTypeLookup` component. An alternative to vanilla's `BatchedMaterialLookup`.

## Improvements

- `activationCondition` and `deactivationCondition` now check for persistent conditions too

## Bug fixes

- Fixed a bug where switching profiles with a controller would make it impossible to leave the menu
- Fixed an issue where splash colours don't get initialized properly for other planets if you spawn on a planet with clouds/water 

**Generated From PR: https://github.com/Outer-Wilds-New-Horizons/new-horizons/pull/1143**
releases.bodyZh:
## 小功能

- 更新中文翻译 (感谢 @SanBaiMing)
- 在 API 中添加 `QueryAddonManifest`，在模组清单中添加 `extras`
- 在 `Base` 中添加 `gravityVolumeLayer`
- 在 `Volumes` 中添加 `quantumToggleVolume`。切换指定量子物体在进入体积时改变其量子状态的能力。
- 为调试射线投射添加了 "空中" 模式。让你能在相机前方选择一个点并获取其位置和旋转。
- 添加 `SurfaceTypeLookup` 组件。范希尔的 `BatchedMaterialLookup` 的替代方案。

## 改进

- `activationCondition` 和 `deactivationCondition` 现在也会检查持久条件

## 错误修复

- 修复了使用控制器切换配置文件时会导致无法离开菜单的 bug
- 修复了如果你在多云/水域行星上生成，其他行星的启动颜色无法正确初始化的问题

releases.name: Version 1.29.2
releases.body:
## Minor features

- Can now implement custom translatable alien languages. This is done on each arc by
setting `customTextImage` to an image path, `legiblePersistentCondition`
for learning the new language, and optionally `customLanguageName` to
give it a name.
- Can now override the color translation text for an arc with `overrideUnreadColor` and optionally `overrideTranslatedColor`
- Can now have a separate ship spawn point for warping into the system with the ship's warp drive with `warpDriveSpawnPointID` in system config. Resolves #1133
- Added `musicFadeInTime`, `musicVolume`, and `ambienceVolume` to title screen configs.
- Added `IsWarpingBackToEye`, `GetCenterOfStarSystem`, `GetPlayerSpawnPoint`, `GetShipSpawnPoint` to API.
- Added `showDescriptionNotAchieved` to achievement info and `DescriptionNotAchieved` to achievement translations.
- Added `campfires` to `Props`. Can set the state to be lit, smoldering, or unlit.
- Added `fuelTanks` to `Props`. Can change type to be the Hearthian tanks or DLC torchs.
- Added `alarmBells` to `Props`. Resolves #1118
- Added `alarmBellPath` to `dreamCampfires`.
- Added `playerRecoveryVolumes` to `Volumes`. Interacting can refuel or heal the player.
- Reveal volumes can now use different shapes.

## Improvements

- Moved `solarSystemVolume` to a better name `starSystemVolumes`.
- `IsWarpingBackToEye` now stops `OnCompleteSceneLoad` from running.
- Now logs if it fails to load your credits.

## Bug fixes

- Somewhat fix ghost birds having broken arms in mods like Examples and Granite's Invitation but Escape Room is still broken ahhhhh why why why why!!!!! Mobius why did you slightly adjust ghost birds in a patch!!!!! No it's okay you're allowed I forgive you.
- Translator tool no longer appears in dream world.
- Fix fonts for different languages on star chart mode. Fixes #1137
- Fix rich presence on quantum planets.
- Fix speed limiter volume exception.
- Fix credits button on title screen not working.
- Fix warping to the Outer Wilds killing you instantly.
- Fix DLC required popup not appearing for some DLC props. 

**Generated From PR: https://github.com/Outer-Wilds-New-Horizons/new-horizons/pull/1135**

- New mod setting to turn off warp drive model.

## Improvements

- Reworked how the warp drive model gets enabled. Now it will only show up if there is two distinct systems that you can enter and exit.

## Bug fixes

- Fixed the disappearance time on the Hearthian Sun in interstellar mode.
- Fixed the broken ambient lights on planets

releases.name: Version 1.29.0
releases.body:
## Major features

- Overhauled the visuals of New Horizons' interstellar mode in the ship
log! Additionally, if your ship is equipped with a warp drive functionally,
there will be a new visual 3D model representing the warp drive on your
ship! Thanks @lezzlebit for implementing this!
- Ability to specify a sector path for things to use, instead of just the planet's top-level sector. Can also automatically find the innermost sector

# Minor features

- Added `sectorPath` to most props to allow specifying a sector other
than the planet's root sector for the purposes of culling and other
sector behavior. The special value `"auto"` finds the first sector in
the prop's parent hierarchy.
- Particle fields
	- No more arbitrary particle limit (slightly breaks back compat since any too large input that was being capped now isn't, but that behavior was pointless and not worth preserving)
	- Override field radius

## Improvements

- Particle fields:
	- More depth in documentation
	- Default rain is now the correct higher density, and snow is equivalent without needing duplicates

## Bug fixes

- Added a security check to ScatterBuilder.
- CurrentStarSystem now prevents invalid values properly. Fixes #1128
- Stranger type translator texts are now colored properly. Fixes #1125
- Star ambient lights are no longer always orange. Fixes #1102
